No intervening protected boundary is crossed and guard evaluation/prefix scopes/statement-position braces remain. Nonzero client-control paths, numeric and wire states, arithmetic, aliasing and original diagnostics remain; no zero-flag assumption. All303 expected token streams, complete ordered Java bindings/overrides and surviving label destinations are checked.
